verdict.rationale: AI Gateway documents spend monitoring across providers in one dashboard. It logs spend and model usage, shows request summaries by project and API key, and lets logs be filtered by model and provider. Per-team and per-team-member dimensions appear only as budget caps, not as documented spend-tracking breakdowns. Missing for 10: explicit per-user and per-team spend reporting views, an explicit per-model spend breakdown (rather than log filtering), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can track spend per model, key, team, or user across all providers in one place
